purpose: Evaluate research-paper understanding before and after fine-tuning

grading_scale.0: Incorrect, missing, or unsupported by the paper
grading_scale.1: Partially correct but incomplete, vague, or containing minor errors
grading_scale.2: Correct, sufficiently complete, and supported by the paper

concept_explanation.description: Explains the paper's central technical concept accurately

checks: Distinguishes the proposed method from existing approaches
Identifies contributions explicitly supported by the paper
Identifies datasets and experimental setup when provided
Describes the method without contradicting the paper
Distinguishes reported details from missing information

experimental_interpretation.description: Interprets experimental results using the reported evidence
checks: Preserves the direction and magnitude of comparisons
Does not invent metrics or experimental findings

limitations.description: Identifies limitations supported by the paper and its evidence
checks: Does not claim that unreported experiments were performed

evaluation_rules: Score each criterion independently from 0 to 2
Judge answers against the source paper, not fluency or answer length
Do not award credit for unsupported claims even when they sound plausible
Use the same rubric for baseline and fine-tuned model outputs
